# Popular Jana Neethi Medicals & Surgicals

> Popular Jana Neethi Medicals & Surgicals is a healthcare pharmacy and surgical supply network in Perinthalmanna and Angadippuram (Malappuram, Kerala) providing prescription & Pradhan Mantri Jan Aushadhi generic medicines, surgical supplies, medical equipment, easy EMI equipment financing, home-care medical equipment rentals, and doorstep medicine delivery via WhatsApp.

## Core Pages & Services
- [Home & Complete Healthcare Overview](https://www.populardrugs.in/): Official website for Popular Jana Neethi Medicals & Surgicals.
- [Medicines & Jan Aushadhi Generics](https://www.populardrugs.in/#service-medicines): Genuine prescription medications, chronic-care refills, affordable Jan Aushadhi generic medicines, and wellness supplements.
- [Surgical Products & Hospital Supplies](https://www.populardrugs.in/#service-surgicals): Stainless steel surgical instruments, sterile gauze, bandages, medical gloves, IV sets, catheters, and clinic consumables.
- [Medical Equipment](https://www.populardrugs.in/#service-equipment): Digital blood pressure monitors, pulse oximeters, nebulizers, glucometers, stethoscopes, and home diagnostic devices.
- [EMI Shopping for Medical Equipment](https://www.populardrugs.in/#service-emi): Easy monthly installment (EMI) plans for oxygen concentrators (5L/10L), CPAP/BiPAP machines, patient monitors, and motorized hospital beds.
- [Medical Equipment Rental](https://www.populardrugs.in/#service-rental): Affordable daily, weekly, and monthly rentals of sanitized Fowler/Semi-Fowler hospital beds, wheelchairs, oxygen concentrators, BiPAP/CPAP units, and air mattresses.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.populardrugs.in/#faq): Direct answers on store locations, rentals, EMI options, home delivery, and opening hours.
